dict.string: Jeeves listens to your voice commands and transcribes them on this Mac.
Jeeves converts your spoken requests to text using on-device speech recognition.
Jeeves reads your schedule and creates events when you ask it to.
Jeeves reads and creates reminders when you ask it to.
Jeeves looks up phone numbers and email addresses so it can message the right person.
Jeeves controls apps such as Notes, Mail and Music on your behalf.
